title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music
excerpt: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus faces Steam review-bombing after players discover AI-generated music tracks in the game.
body_html:
The developer of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus has removed artificial intelligence-generated music from the game following negative user reviews on Steam. Players recently discovered that a specific portion of the game utilized AI tracks during a section themed around Grand Theft Auto.

The discovery was initially made public by a Reddit user, who found audio files containing Suno metadata linked to the music used in that section. Following the revelation, the game experienced a wave of negative reviews on the Steam platform before the content was taken out.
